MCP tool reference

Every tool the server exposes.

30 tools. The names come from the tool contract in packages/core/src/agentic_odi_core/contract.py, which a contract test asserts against the live FastMCP registry — and the signatures come from the server source itself.

add_job get_jobs get_job update_job delete_job add_step get_job_map get_step update_step delete_step add_outcome get_outcomes get_outcome update_outcome delete_outcome add_customer_outcome get_customer_outcome list_customer_outcomes update_customer_outcome delete_customer_outcome add_evidence get_evidence list_evidence delete_evidence promote_evidence evaluate_outcome get_odi_schema compute_opportunity get_odi_framework_guidelines get_capabilities

odi_schema 8 entities

The canonical JSON schema for every ODI entity. The server returns it from get_odi_schema, and an agent can read it to learn the shape of the data before it writes anything.
